## Details

<a id="building_kind_hit"></a>
### [`building_kind_hit`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L6) `$4003`

*variable*

Game variables $4003-$40f7. The image holds the values of the cracker's capture; game start sets most of them.
Hit flag per building kind 0-3. 1: $7001 draws the kind with dithered chars. $6796 sets it; $4d64 clears it for a new building.

- **Read by:** [`animate_chars`](../screen/animate_chars.md#animate_chars)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`pick_building_type`](../ground/country_row.md#pick_building_type), [`city_build_shape`](../ground/city.md#city_build_shape), [`destroy_object`](../ground/ground_hits.md#destroy_object)

<a id="building_kind_hit_1"></a>
### [`building_kind_hit_1`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L8) `$4004`

*variable*

Hit flag of building kind 1 (see building_kind_hit).

- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start)

<a id="building_kind_hit_2"></a>
### [`building_kind_hit_2`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L10) `$4005`

*variable*

Hit flag of building kind 2 (see building_kind_hit).

- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start)

<a id="building_kind_hit_3"></a>
### [`building_kind_hit_3`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L12) `$4006`

*variable*

Hit flag of building kind 3 (see building_kind_hit).

- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start)

<a id="option_line"></a>
### [`option_line`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L13) `$4007`

*variable*

Selected option line 0-2 on the title screen. F3 steps it; F5 changes the option of this line.

- **Read by:** [`title_screen`](../screen/title_screen.md#title_screen)
- **Written by:** [`title_screen`](../screen/title_screen.md#title_screen)

<a id="opt_gravity"></a>
### [`opt_gravity`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L14) `$4008`

*variable*

Option GRAVITY: 1 on. $6fe8 lowers the altitude when the stick is centred. The rank formula uses it.

- **Read by:** [`plane_apply_gravity`](../plane/plane_states.md#plane_apply_gravity), [`title_screen`](../screen/title_screen.md#title_screen), [`show_options`](../screen/title_options.md#show_options), [`rank_after_crash`](../game/rank.md#rank_after_crash), [`rank_after_mission`](../game/rank.md#rank_after_mission)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`title_screen`](../screen/title_screen.md#title_screen)

<a id="opt_reverse_control"></a>
### [`opt_reverse_control`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L15) `$4009`

*variable*

Option control: 0 NORMAL CONTROL (stick up climbs; $593e swaps the up and down bits), 1 PILOT CONTROL (stick down climbs).

- **Read by:** [`plane_control`](../plane/plane_control.md#plane_control)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start)

<a id="opt_skill_level"></a>
### [`opt_skill_level`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L16) `$400A`

*variable*

Option skill level 0-2 (BEGINNER first). It sets difficulty, airfield_gap and flak_chance.

- **Read by:** [`$4458`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L83), [`$4466`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L90), [`$447F`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L104), [`rank_after_crash_skill`](../game/rank.md#rank_after_crash_skill), [`rank_after_mission`](../game/rank.md#rank_after_mission)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start)

<a id="difficulty"></a>
### [`difficulty`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L17) `$400B`

*variable*

airfields_passed + opt_skill_level. Random threshold for wind ($5e50) and for runway attacker bombs ($5fb6).

- **Read by:** [`update_wind`](../plane/wind.md#update_wind), [`enemy_bomb_drop`](../enemy/runway_attacker.md#enemy_bomb_drop)
- **Written by:** [`$445B`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L84)

<a id="map_row_ptr"></a>
### [`map_row_ptr`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L18) `$400C`

*variable*

Address of the newest map row in the buffer $8000-$977f. scroll_next_row subtracts $7f per row and wraps to $977f.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame), [`build_map_row`](../ground/map_row.md#build_map_row), [`scroll_next_row`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_next_row)
- **Written by:** [`scroll_next_row`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_next_row)

<a id="map_row_ptr_hi"></a>
### [`map_row_ptr_hi`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L19) `$400D`

*variable*

High byte of map_row_ptr.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame), [`build_map_row`](../ground/map_row.md#build_map_row), [`scroll_next_row`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_next_row)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`scroll_next_row`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_next_row)

<a id="scroll_fine_x"></a>
### [`scroll_fine_x`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L20) `$400E`

*variable*

Fine horizontal scroll 6,4,2,0 for $d016. scroll_step subtracts 2 per scroll frame.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame), [`map_tile_addr`](../ground/map_tile.md#map_tile_addr), [`scroll_step`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_step)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`scroll_step`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_step)

<a id="scroll_fine_y"></a>
### [`scroll_fine_y`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L21) `$400F`

*variable*

Fine vertical scroll 0,2,4,6 for $d011. scroll_step adds 2 per scroll frame.

- **Read by:** [`$4365`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L20), [`$438B`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L38), [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame), [`map_tile_addr`](../ground/map_tile.md#map_tile_addr), [`scroll_step`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_step)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`scroll_step`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_step)

<a id="map_row_index"></a>
### [`map_row_index`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L22) `$4010`

*variable*

Index 0-$2f of the newest map row in the tables map_row_lo/map_row_hi. Counts down per row.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame), [`build_map_row`](../ground/map_row.md#build_map_row), [`city_row`](../ground/city.md#city_row), [`map_tile_addr`](../ground/map_tile.md#map_tile_addr), [`scroll_next_row`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_next_row)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`scroll_next_row`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_next_row)

<a id="screen_copy_done"></a>
### [`screen_copy_done`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L23) `$4011`

*variable*

0: the IRQ copies the map window into the back screen and sets 1. scroll_next_row clears it.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame)
- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](../init/game_start.md#cold_start), [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame), [`scroll_next_row`](../plane/plane_states.md#scroll_next_row)

<a id="map_copy_ptr"></a>
### [`map_copy_ptr`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L24) `$4014`

*variable*

Source address of the screen copy. The IRQ writes it into the LDA operands at $4789.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame)
- **Written by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame)

<a id="map_copy_ptr_hi"></a>
### [`map_copy_ptr_hi`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L25) `$4015`

*variable*

High byte of map_copy_ptr.

- **Read by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame)
- **Written by:** [`irq_frame`](../irq/frame_irq.md#irq_frame)

<a id="joy_state"></a>
### [`joy_state`](../../../../src/data/variables.asm#L26) `$4016`
